name: Emblm
positioning: Emblm is the branded merchandise platform for enterprise procurement teams — one governed catalog, global fulfillment, and spend you can actually forecast.

hero.h1: Branded merchandise, governed like every other line item.
hero.sub: Emblm gives enterprise procurement a single approved catalog, automated brand controls, and global on-demand fulfillment — so swag stops being a rogue expense and starts being a managed program.

features.title: Governed brand catalog
features.description: Lock logos, Pantone values, and approved SKUs into one catalog. Every order routes through brand and legal rules before a single unit is produced.

features.title: Usage-based spend visibility
features.description: Track redemption, per-department burn, and cost-per-unit in real time. Export straight to your ERP with GL codes already mapped.

features.title: Global on-demand fulfillment
features.description: Produce and ship from 14 regional hubs. No pre-buys, no dead inventory sitting in a warehouse against a forecast that changed.

features.title: Automated approval routing
features.description: Configure spend thresholds, cost centers, and approver chains once. Requests escalate automatically and clear an audit trail.

features.title: SSO and role controls
features.description: SCIM provisioning, SAML SSO, and granular roles for admins, requesters, and regional leads across every subsidiary.

features.title: Redemption programs
features.description: Send new-hire kits, event drops, and recognition rewards with named recipient links and delivery confirmation at scale.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated 40 rogue vendor accounts into one governed catalog. Brand compliance went from a quarterly cleanup to a non-issue, and finance finally trusts the swag line.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor

testimonials.quote: The usage-based model matched our actual behavior. We stopped ordering 5,000 hoodies to hit a minimum and now pay per unit shipped. Dead inventory dropped to zero.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feltrin

testimonials.quote: Onboarding 900 new hires a quarter used to mean spreadsheets and a warehouse. Emblm ships named kits on demand with delivery confirmation we can audit.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For single teams standardizing their branded merch spend.
For multi-department orgs that need controls and reporting.
For global procurement with subsidiary-level governance.

homepage.footerBlurb: Emblm is the governed branded merchandise platform for the enterprise. One catalog, controlled spend, global fulfillment on demand.
